description: Sequencer on a 32 by 32 grid of typed characters, read by up to sixteen play heads that turn each character into a voltage

params.text: Moves the play head across the columns
Moves the play head across the rows
The share of cells a random fill gives a character rather than a space, 0 to 1; the README describes it as setting how many spaces are generated
Fills the grid, or the selected block, with random characters between the two Range knobs
The voltage one step of the character table is worth, 0.01V to 1V; at one twelfth of a volt the characters run in semitones and A is A two octaves below middle A
The lowest character a random fill can write, by its place in the ASCII table, 33 to 126
The highest character a random fill can write, by its place in the ASCII table, 33 to 126

inputs.text: Places a play head on a column for each of its channels, the 32 columns spread over 0-10V, added to the CvX knob and wrapped around
Places a play head on a row for each of its channels, the 32 rows spread over 0-10V, added to the CvY knob and wrapped around
Sets that share, 0-10V across the whole range, and overrides the Dens knob while patched
Sets the level directly, 0-1V, one channel per play head
A rising edge fills the grid, or the selected block, with random characters between the two Range knobs
A rising edge writes the note at the CV input into the cell under the cursor as the character that plays it back
The pitch that is written in as a character when a trigger arrives at the Trg input, read as 1V/octave

outputs.text: The character under the play head as a voltage: its place in the character table, counted from P at zero, times the level
Carries 10V on a play head's channel while the character under it is anything but a space
A 1ms trigger on a play head's channel when the character under that head changes

notes: the grid comes up filled with spaces, which hold the gate output at 0V and the CV output at zero: type characters in, press Rnd, or play notes into the CV and Trg inputs
the cursor can be moved over the grid and typed into, and PageUp and PageDown step the character under it up and down the ASCII table
a block of cells can be selected for cut, copy and paste, text pastes in from the system clipboard, and every edit goes into Rack's undo history
menu: Clear — empties the whole grid to spaces
Color Mode — draws the grid in Blue, Matrix or Grey

inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.6: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
